NOVOOI AS is a private limited company (AS) based in Oslo, founded 2021. Registered industry: Industri-, produkt- og motedesignvirksomhet (NACE 74.110; line of business: other professional, scientific and technical activities). Registered activity (as written in the register): Selge varer og tjenester innen design og håndverk - og annet som naturlig sammenfaller med dette - samt deltakelse i andre selskaper, investeringer og nærliggende virksomhet. Its website describes it as: "Curated Norwegian interior design shop and agency, for professionals and conscious consumers. Showroom in Oslo. Global shipping". Registered employees: fewer than 5 (the register withholds the exact number).
For 2025 it reported operating revenue of NOK 541 thousand, a net result of -NOK 2.2 million, equity of NOK 508 thousand. Revenue was up 191.6% from 2024.
Leadership: Lillian Ayla B Ersoy is chief executive; Peter Torgeir Nylund chairs the board; 5 board member(s) in total.
